reviews.title: Fertility Consultation Booking
reviews.body:
# Fertility Consultation Booking

Allows scheduling fertility consultations.

Supports

• Clinic

• Physician

• Online Consultation

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Fertility consultations reuse clinic/physician/online booking. A reserved appointment neither authorizes a procedure nor starts a treatment cycle.

reviews.title: Couple Fertility Profile
reviews.body:
# Couple Fertility Profile

Creates a shared reproductive health profile for partners.

Supports

• Female Data

• Male Data

• Shared Treatment Timeline

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Shared treatment context is a projection linking two separately identified patients. Preserve female/male source categories without assuming sex, parental status or automatic partner access. Independent purpose-scoped grants and withdrawal apply to each source; absence of permission is distinct from absence of clinical data. Never merge partner patient IDs or disclose hidden diagnoses through timeline titles.

reviews.title: Infertility Diagnosis Registry
reviews.body:
# Infertility Diagnosis Registry

Stores infertility diagnoses.

Supports

• Female Factors

• Male Factors

• Combined Factors

• Unexplained Infertility

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Female/male/combined/unexplained infertility, stimulation response, pregnancy after assisted reproduction and the specialty workspace are distinct profiles. Preserve follicles/estradiol/medication response and early pregnancy imaging/labs while keeping source ownership and clinician decisions separate. No success guarantee, inferred embryo viability or autonomous stimulation recommendation.

reviews.title: IVF Treatment Registry
reviews.body:
# IVF Treatment Registry

Stores in vitro fertilization treatment history.

Supports

• Stimulation

• Egg Retrieval

• Fertilization

• Embryo Transfer

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: IVF cycles link stimulation, retrieval, fertilization and transfer as distinct procedures. Preserve retrieval count/quality/notes and transfer date/grade/physician notes with source version and specimen linkage. Count/grade does not establish suitability, consent or transfer authorization.

reviews.title: Embryo Registry
reviews.body:
# Embryo Registry

Stores embryo information.

Supports

• Development Stage

• Grading

• Cryopreservation

• Transfer History

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Embryology and hormone observations use separate specimen/result profiles under laboratory ownership. Retain developmental stage/grading, cryopreservation/transfer and embryo/egg/sperm storage identity/custody separately from patient IDs; hormone AMH/LH/FSH/estradiol/progesterone retain units/method/reference/timing. Storage or shared treatment linkage never authorizes disposal, donation, transfer or partner disclosure. Custody and consent state require specialist-validated contracts.

reviews.title: Fertility Success Analytics
reviews.body:
# Fertility Success Analytics

Provides treatment outcome statistics.

Displays

• Cycles

• Pregnancy Rate

• Live Birth Rate

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Cycle, pregnancy and live-birth rates are different cohort outcomes with explicit denominator, follow-up, treatment context and missingness. Aggregates are not individual predictions or comparable clinic rankings without population adjustment and evidence.

reviews.title: Reproductive AI Assistant
reviews.body:
# Reproductive AI Assistant

AI assists reproductive treatment monitoring.

Analyzes

• Hormones

• Ultrasound

• Laboratory Results

• Treatment Timeline

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: Hormone, ultrasound, lab and treatment-timeline analysis is a bounded AI task requiring source/model versions, validation, uncertainty and human disposition. No independent selection, grading, stimulation dose or reproductive decision.

reviews.title: International Fertility Tourism
reviews.body:
# International Fertility Tourism

Allows comparison of fertility clinics worldwide.

Displays

• Country

• City

• Success Rate

• Cost

• Reviews

Status

Documentation

---
reviews.verdict: International fertility clinic comparison preserves country/city/cost/reviews/success-rate intent, but CAP-TRAVEL versus provider-directory/analytics composition requires further semantic comparison. Rates need denominator, follow-up and cohort comparability; cross-border treatment eligibility and jurisdiction are not established. REVIEWED_ONLY, no normalization or canonicalization.
